purpose: Defines the single reachable OpenHands Workspace source-adoption contract.

source_scope.rule: Approved OpenHands product-mechanics scope is defined in source-scope.json; this blueprint records only high-level surfaces, while the actual local import closure is verified for completeness, resolvability, and orphan-free reachability.
adopted_surfaces: ConversationMain split-panel composition and docked panel visibility
Research Thread and Research Inspector docked split-panel mechanics
excluded_surfaces: Frontend API, Agent Runtime, authentication, and WebSocket integration
Terminal, editor, browser, Git, repository, sandbox, and deployment surfaces
Foreign reasoning renderers, extractors and unfiltered runtime payloads
Any source outside the single entrypoint dependency closure

source_policy.role: Privacy and product-boundary policy layered over the reachable source closure.
source_policy.precedence: EXCLUDED, DEFERRED_NOT_VENDORED, and source-policy constraints take precedence over source adoption.

preserve_mechanics: Research Thread/Inspector docked split-panel resize and visibility
Command overlay focus and keyboard behavior
Research Thread/Inspector split-panel sizing, keyboard control, and persistence
Loading, empty, running, error, cancel, retry, and recovery states
Expandable tool-event rows and grouped action-result presentation
Disclosure interaction without model-private reasoning semantics
replace_domain_only: Visible Xingwen labels and disconnected Agent state copy
Persisted Thread entries, Contract/Run projections, and Inspector cards
Legacy Activity/Context tab content removed from the retained panel frame

vendored_source_forbidden: Fake project, run, artifact, or evidence data

reasoning_boundary.public_step_analysis: server-validated public_analysis inside the authorized project Thread only
reasoning_boundary.provider_private_reasoning: never enters the Workspace event or presentation boundary
reasoning_boundary.ui_mechanics: preserve the upstream CollapsibleThinking disclosure interaction

hard_rules: One Workspace shell and one entrypoint.
Approved mechanics are recorded independently from the actual import closure.
Every vendored source file is reachable from the workspace mechanics root.tsx.
Every local import in the vendored closure resolves on disk.
No compatibility layer or dormant upstream facade.
Every adapted file records its frozen upstream path and modification reason.
Provider-private reasoning never enters RunEvents, shares, exports or formal Artifacts.

source_vendor_completion_contract.requirement: Every adopted source-scope entry has a real vendored file in the single entrypoint closure.

provenance_contract: provenance.json provides the exact disk mapping of the adopted mechanics files; import-closure checks derive reachability from the mechanics root.tsx.
